# Approvers against Bhagat Singh and others in Lahore Conspiracy Case of 1929
# The 1928 murder of British officer Saunders was revenge for Lala Lajpat Rai's death during a protest against the Simon Commission. Members of Revolutionary HSRA took the responsibility.
# In 1929, Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw bombs in the Central Legislative Assembly to protest British bills. They surrendered to use the trial as a platform.
